title: Filtered colimits of smooth algebras and products
statement: Let $R_1\to\Lambda_1$ and $R_2\to\Lambda_2$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings such that, for $i=1,2$, $\Lambda_i$ is a filtered colimit of smooth $R_i$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-filtered-colimit-smooth-algebras]. Then $\Lambda_1\times\Lambda_2$, an $R_1\times R_2$-algebra via the product map $(r_1,r_2)\mapsto(\varphi_1(r_1),\varphi_2(r_2))$, is a filtered colimit of smooth $R_1\times R_2$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. (Stacks states this inside Situation 07F2, i.e. for regular maps $R_i\to\Lambda_i$ of Noetherian rings; its hint, 'a product of filtered colimits is a filtered colimit', does not use these hypotheses, and the statement here omits them.)

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, Lemma Tag 07F3 (lemma-product, line 1926), stated in Situation Tag 07F2; proof 'Omitted. Hint: A product of filtered colimits is a filtered colimit.'
